patch.value: Source: https://github.com/unbraind/pm-cli/issues/1446. Public reproduction uses pm-beads main at 25561a2 and references prior issues 1200/1202 plus downstream workaround pm-beads PR 138. This is a reported upgrade behavior, not a verified current regression. Do not run force reconciliation on real downstream data during intake.
Preserve reviewed legacy merge receipts across SDK upgrades

GitHub 1446 reports that unchanged pm-beads receipts reviewed by older merge_reconcile events are gated again after upgrading from 2026.10.8 to 2026.10.9. The advertised dry-run cannot prove snapshots and omits the documented force-review recovery. Reproduce on immutable downstream data and determine the compatible settled-receipt and recovery contract without destructive receipt cleanup.

Reproduce 2026.10.8, 2026.10.9 and current SDK against isolated exact downstream data; distinguish historical reviewed receipt proof from unreviewed decisions; preserve immutable evidence and unchanged bytes on refusals; any force review guidance names its audit requirements; independent regressions and all-source coverage pass.
Reviewed legacy receipts retain auditable settlement or have explicit safe migration guidance before a strict health gate changes.
